community.status.missingApiKey: An API key is required for community activity and chat.
community.error.offline: Community is offline. Please wait for a connection.
chat.title: Community Chat
chat.description: Talk in the lobby, a game room or a direct conversation, and see who is online and what they are playing.
chat.presenceHint: Saved for this account. Others see it while PlayStash is open.
chat.info: Messages are plain text. The server retains at most 100 messages per conversation for 24 hours; a server restart clears this history.
chat.activity.title: Online Activity
chat.empty: No recent messages in this conversation.

chat.error.unconfirmed: Delivery is unconfirmed. Retry uses the same message ID to avoid duplicates.
chat.error.rejected: The server rejected this chat action.

communitySettings.chatDescription: Not shown for your own messages, while you are invisible, or for the conversation you are viewing.
communitySettings.activity: Show notifications when community activity changes
